correctness.rationale: F_m=t∏a_i−Σb_i²∏_{j≠i}a_j is primitive linear in t, so irreducible; each G_i similarly. At corank 1 at least one diagonal adjugate derivative is nonzero because adj(M)=c vv^T and some v_j²≠0 over C; hence singular iff corank≥2. Inverting nonzero leaf diagonals and separating k=0,1,2,≥3 zero leaves yields EXACT union Y_i=V(a_i,b_i,G_i) and L_ijk=V(a_i,a_j,a_k); each codim3, Y_i irreducible degree m and each L degree1, generic noncontainment, reduced support degree m²+binom(m,3). Generic Y chart gives a_i τ−b_i², generic L chart gives a nondegenerate 3-variable quadratic form Hessian determinant −2b_i²b_j²b_k² plus cubic, formally uv−w². R1 and S2 imply normality. Checked definitions, projective dimensions, k=2/boundary and m=3. Package finite checker only confirms bounded point samples and is not substituted for scheme-theoretic proof.
